summary: Complete frontend testing of ProductPage glassmorphism design and Admin panel tabs with theme switching. All features working correctly in both light and dark themes.

ProductPage_display: Product image with glassmorphism card styling
ProductPage_theme_switching: Dark theme: zinc-950 background, orange accents, orange 'В КОРЗИНУ' button
Light theme: cyan-pink gradient background, teal/emerald accents, teal/green 'В КОРЗИНУ' button
Glassmorphism cards adapt correctly to both themes
Theme toggle button (guest-theme-toggle) works for non-logged users
Theme toggle in header works for logged-in users
ProductPage_interactions: Quantity selector: Plus button increases quantity
Quantity selector: Minus button decreases quantity
Add to cart button works for logged-in users
Toast notification shows product added to cart with quantity
Cart badge updates in header after adding
Favorites toggle adds product with toast 'Добавлено в избранное'
Back to catalog link navigates correctly
Admin_panel_navigation: All 6 main tabs visible: Каталог, Бонусы, Платежи, CRM, Маркетинг, Настройки
Stats cards display correctly (Users: 5, Products: 1, Orders: 26, Revenue: 338,420.25 ₽)
Admin_Payments_tab: Payments tab loads with sub-tabs: Способы оплаты, Предоплата, Криптовалюта
Payment methods sub-tab shows: Bank card (ЮKassa), Cash, Crypto (USDT/USDC), Balance
Each payment method has toggle switch and adjustment percentage input
Prepayment sub-tab shows min/max topup amount settings
Crypto sub-tab shows wallet address inputs (ETH, BSC, Base, TRC-20)
isDark prop correctly applies dark/light theme styling
Admin_CRM_tab: CRM tab loads with sub-tabs: Клиенты, Аналитика
Clients sub-tab shows summary cards: Активные (4), VIP (0), Оптовики (1)
Client table displays: name, email, phone, status, balance, registration date
Customer status badges styled correctly (Оптовик, Розница)
Analytics sub-tab has period selector and stats display
isDark prop correctly applies theme styling
Admin_Marketing_tab: Marketing tab loads with sub-tabs: Акции и баннер, Новости, Рассылки
Promo sub-tab shows banner configuration (text, link, color, height)
News sub-tab shows news list management
isDark prop correctly applies theme styling
Admin_Settings_tab: Settings tab loads with sub-tabs: Telegram, Импорт/Экспорт, Партнёры, Правила
Telegram sub-tab shows bot token and chat ID inputs
isDark prop correctly applies theme styling
Admin_theme_switching: Dark theme: zinc-950 background, orange accents on active tabs
Light theme: light gray background, teal/green accents on active tabs
All internal tab content (PaymentsTab, CRMTab, MarketingTab, SettingsTab) respect isDark prop
Sub-tabs change color scheme appropriately for each theme

critical_code_review_comments: All admin tab components (PaymentsTab.js, CRMTab.js, MarketingTab.js, SettingsTab.js) properly receive and use isDark prop
ProductPage.js correctly uses useTheme() context for theme-aware styling
Glassmorphism CSS classes (glass-card) work in both themes
data-testid attributes present on interactive elements
